messages:
Evelyn: FYI received invoice from OrionGrid (INV-2026-089) for $58,320 — PDF doesn't show any PO. attaching the scan. Can AP hold payment until we sort this? /cc @Raj @Ana

invoices-bot: invoice uploaded to payments queue: invoices/2026/OrionGrid_INV-2026-089.pdf (size: 412KB)

Raj: On it. Do we have a PO on record? I only see a small request last month. If no PO, we'll need an approver override per policy.

Mike: AP here — I can stop the auto-pay if you confirm. Please confirm cost center and whether this should be routed to a purchase order match or manual approval.

Ana: This was for Eng Runtime GPU hours (monthly burst). I recall a procurement request but not a matched PO for the full amount. Could be overages billed by vendor.

Raj: I searched procurement: found PO-OR-3384 for OrionGrid, amount $45,000, approved by Tsur. That doesn't cover the full $58,320.

Tsur: Confirmed — we approved PO-OR-3384 for the committed capacity. We did exceed usage during the run, vendor said they'd bill overage on top of PO. Didn't expect this much.

Mike: Per AP policy: invoices > $50k must have a PO or exec approval. This invoice is $58,320 so needs either a PO match or explicit authorizing approval. I will mark it HOLD until we get confirmation.

Evelyn: I'll ping OrionGrid for an itemized breakout and request they either reissue split invoices (PO-backed amount + overage) or include the PO reference on the invoice.

Tsur: Thanks. If they can split, we can approve the PO-backed portion immediately and route the overage to Taylor for approval.

Taylor: I'm OOO most of today but I can approve an ad-hoc overage if Procurement + Eng provide justification and contract clause. Otherwise hold payment and initiate dispute with vendor. Legal: loop in if contract terms don't match.

Mike: Noted. I've set AP flag "hold:invoice" and added task AP-6241 to prevent auto-pay for the cycle.

Evelyn: Opening ticket with OrionGrid now — copying vendor contact: billing@oriongrid.ai. Message: "Invoice INV-2026-089 received without PO reference; please either reissue with PO-OR-3384 referenced or split into two invoices (PO amount $45,000 + overage $13,320) with explanation of usage overage."

Evelyn: (paste from PDF header)
```
Invoice: INV-2026-089
Date: 2026-03-18
Amount: $58,320.00
PO: (none)
```

Raj: I'll update the procurement request to reflect the overage and link AP-6241.

Mike: Thanks — AP will await vendor reply and Taylor's confirmation for any approval overage. Leaving a reaction :hourglass_flowing_sand:.

Evelyn: Will update thread when vendor responds. For now invoice is on hold. :+1:
